lifecycle_events.AUTH_LOGIN_UID_A: Stream listener attached -> catalog hydrated -> snapshotReady -> render missions
lifecycle_events.AUTH_LOGOUT: autoDispose cancels Firestore stream listener -> state cleared -> no stale snapshot
lifecycle_events.AUTH_RELOGIN_UID_A: New stream listener created -> catalog rehydrated immediately without hot restart
lifecycle_events.AUTH_LOGIN_UID_B: Isolated UID-B subscription created -> zero UID-A leakage
